data.contenido:
Menli mɔtwɛ pɛ a pɛle Azuyilɛ ne a, noko mekɛ hɔle bie la bɛ nwo zonle bɛyɛle apenle apenle dɔɔnwo. Na, Azuyilɛ ne anzi ɛvolɛ 352, bɛwole Ebileham. Yɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle zile lile ye ɛwɔkɛ zo manle Ebileham wole ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ayezeke la. Akee, wɔ Ayezeke amra mrenya nwiɔ ne anu, Nyamenle kpale nu yele Gyekɔbo.

Gyekɔbo nyianle abusua kpole mɔɔ mralɛ mrenya 12 yɛɛ mralɛ mraalɛ noko wɔ nu a. Gyekɔbo amra mrenya 10 ne kpɔle bɛ diema kakula Dwosefi na bɛdɔnenle ye bɛhɔle Yigyibiti akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu. Amozii, Dwosefi rayɛle tumivolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ la wɔ Yigyibiti. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔne kpole bie rale la, Dwosefi zɔle ɔ mediema ne mɔ nleanle kɛ bɛnyia adwenle nzenzaleɛ a. Awieleɛ kolaa ne, Gyekɔbo abusua ne amuala, Yizilayɛma ne, dule hɔle Yigyibiti. Bɛwole Ebileham ɔ nzi ɛvolɛ 290 kolaa na ɛhye azi.

Wɔ ɛvolɛ 215 mɔɔ doale ye la anu, Yizilayɛma ne dɛnlanle Yigyibiti. Wɔ Dwosefi ewule nzi, bɛrayɛle ngɛkɛlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ. Mekɛ hɔle bie la, bɛwole Mosisi, na Nyamenle luale ɔ nwo zo liele Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti. Wɔ ɔ muala anu, ɛvolɛ 857 anu tetedwɛkɛ a wɔ Foa NWIƆ ne anu a.

ASOO ɛze debie mɔɔ Nowa lumua yɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee ye abusua ne vi ɛlɛne ne anu vindele la ɔ? Ɔbɔle afɔle ɔmanle Nyamenle. Ɛkola ɛnwu ye wɔ nvoninli ne mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛkɛ ne la anu kɛ ɔlɛyɛ ɛhye. Nowa vale nane bɔle afɔle ɛhye lale Nyamenle ase kɛ yelie ye abusua ne yevi azuyilɛ kpole ne anu la.

Asoo ɛdie ɛdi kɛ Gyihova anye zɔle afɔle ne ɔ? Ɛhɛe, ɔ nye zɔle ye. Yemɔti ɔbɔle Nowa ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔnrɛva azuyilɛ ɔnrɛzɛkye ewiade ye bieko ɛlɛ.



Yeangyɛ biala azɛlɛ ne azo amuala yɛle resee, na Nowa nee ye abusua ne mɔɔ bɛvi ɛlɛne ne anu bɛvindele la bɔle asetɛnla fofolɛ bo. Nyamenle yilale bɛ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛwo mralɛ dɔɔnwo. Bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛzo ɔhɔdwu kɛ menli badɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo ɛleka biala.’

Noko amozii, saa menli te azuyilɛ kpole ne anwo edwɛkɛ a, bie a bɛbazulo kɛ azuyilɛ zɔhane bieko bara. Yemɔti Nyamenle vale debie mɔɔ bahakye menli ye ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ yebɔ kɛ ɔnrɛmaa azuyilɛ ɛnrɛzɛkye azɛlɛ ye amuala bieko la ɔmanle. Ɛze debie mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle amaa yeahakye bɛ la ɔ? Nyangondonle ɔ.

Nyangondonle ta to anwomanyunlu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ezule kɛdɔ kɛwie na ewia ne ɛlɛfi la. Nyangondonle bahola anyia kɔla ngɛnlɛma ngɛnlɛma dɔɔnwo. Wɔnwu bie ɛlɛ ɔ? Asoo ɛnwu mɔɔ wɔ nvoninli ye anu la ɔ?

Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle hanle la ɛne: ‘Mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ azuyilɛ ɛnrɛzɛkye menli nee nane amuala bieko ɛlɛ. Mebado me nyangondonle ne wɔ anwomanyunlu. Na mekɛ biala mɔɔ nyangondonle kɛdo la, mebanwu ye na meahakye me ɛwɔkɛ ne.’

Yemɔti saa ɛnwu nyangondonle a, duzu a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkakye wɔ a? Ɛhɛe, Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle kɛ ɔnrɛva azuyilɛ kpole ɔnrɛzɛkye ewiade ye bieko la ɔ.Mɔlebɛbo 8:18-22; 9:9-17. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ƐVOLƐ dɔɔnwo pɛle nu. Nowa amra ne mɔ wole mralɛ dɔɔnwo. Na bɛ mra ne mɔ nyinle na bɛwole mralɛ dɔɔnwo. Yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ azɛlɛ ne azo yɛle menli ngome a.

Menli ɛhye mɔ anu ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Nemelɔdo la le Nowa alɔnra kansoa. Ɛnee ɔle sonla ɛtane mɔɔ lile bɔlɛ hunle nane nee menli muala a. Nemelɔdo eza yɛle ɔ nwo belemgbunli lile menli nwo zo. Nyamenle angulo Nemelɔdo edwɛkɛ. Ɛnee menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ mekɛ zɔhane la amuala ka aneɛ ko. Na ɛnee Nemelɔdo kpondɛ kɛ ɔka bɛ ɔbɔ nuhua na ɔdi bɛ nwo zo. Ɔti ɛze mɔɔ ɔyɛle a? Ɔhanle ɔhilele menli ne kɛ bɛkyekye suakpole ko na bɛzi tawa tendendenlenle ko wɔ nuhua. Nea kɛ bɛwɔ nvoninli ne anu mɔɔ bɛlɛpɛ belekese ɛ.

Gyihova Nyamenle anye anlie suakpole ne ɛkyekyelɛ ne anwo. Ɛnee Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ menli ne tɛlɛ na bɛtɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo ɛleka biala. Noko menli ne mɔ hanle kɛ: ‘Bɛrɛla! Bɛmaa yɛkyekye suakpole ko na yɛzi tawa tendendenlenle ko mɔɔ kɔ anwuma kpalɛ kpalɛ la. Na yɛva yɛlie duma!’ Ɛnee menli ne kpondɛ duma amaa bɛ nwo, na tɛ Nyamenle ɔ.

Yemɔti Nyamenle manle menli ne gyakyile tawa ne ɛzilɛ. Ɛze kɛzi ɔyɛle ye la ɔ? Kɛ anrɛɛ bɛkɛha aneɛ ko la ɔmanle bɛ aneɛ ne hakyile yɛle ngakyile ngakyile arɛlevilɛ nu. Suazivoma ne ande bɛ nwo aneɛ bieko. Ɛhye ati a bɛravɛlɛle bɛ suakpole ne Babelɔn, mɔɔ ɔ bo a le “Basabasayɛlɛ” la.

Menli ne akee bɔle ɔ bo dule vile Babelɔn hɔle. Ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ te bɛ nwo aneɛ la hɔdɛnlanle ɛleka ko wɔ azɛlɛ ne foa bie azo.Mɔlebɛbo 10:1, 8-10; 11:1-⁠9. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

BƐFƐLƐ ɛleka mɔɔ menli hɔdɛnlanle wɔ Azuyilɛ ne anzi la anu ko Yule. Ɔrayɛle suakpole titile mɔɔ ɛnee azua ngɛnlɛma wɔ zo. Noko ɛnee menli mɔɔ wɔ zo la sonle awozonle. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛyɛle ye wɔ Babelɔn noko a. Menli mɔɔ wɔ Yule nee Babelɔn la ɛnee ɛnle kɛ Nowa nee ɔ ra Hyɛm, mɔɔ hɔle zolɛ zonlenle Gyihova la.

Awieleɛ kolaa, wɔ azuyilɛ ne anzi ɛvolɛ 350, nɔhalilɛnli Nowa wule. Ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ anzi ala a bɛwole nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ nvoninli ɛhye anu la. Ɛnee ɔle sonla titile kpalɛ ɔmaa Nyamenle. Ye duma a le Ebileham. Ɛnee ɔ nee ye abusua ne de suakpole Yule azo.

Kenle ko Gyihova hanle hilele Ebileham kɛ: ‘Ɛvi Yule, wɔ maanle ye anu tu, ye ɛ nwo fi ɛ nwo amra avinli, na kɔ maanle ne mɔɔ mebahile wɔ la anu.’ Asoo Ebileham diele Nyamenle na ɔgyakyile anwodɔlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yule la amuala ɔ nzi ɔhɔle ɔ? Ɛhɛe, ɔyɛle ye zɔ. Na ɔluakɛ ɛnee dahuu Ebileham tie Nyamenle la ati a bɛravɛlɛle ye Nyamenle agɔnwo a.

Ebileham abusua ne anu amra bie mɔ nee ye hɔle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛvi Yule la. Ɔ ze Tilaa hɔle bie. Yɛɛ ye awozoa Lɔɔto noko. Yɛɛ akee Ebileham aye Sɛla noko hɔle bie. Mekɛ hɔle bie la bɛ muala bɛhɔdwule ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Hɛlan, ɛleka mɔɔ Tilaa wule la. Ɛnee bɛ nee Yule avinli twe kpalɛ.

Mekɛ hɔle ekyii la Ebileham nee ye abusua ne vile Hɛlan na bɛrale azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Keena la azo. Gyihova hanle ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛ: ‘Azɛlɛ mɔɔ mebava meamaa ɛ bo zo amra la ɛne.’ Ebileham dɛnlanle Keena wɔ ɛdanlɛ sua nu.

Nyamenle bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔboa Ebileham na ɔranyianle mboane nee nane gyɛne dɔɔnwo yɛɛ ngɛkɛlɛ ɛya ɛya dɔɔnwo. Noko ɛnee ɔ nee Sɛla ɛnlɛ ralɛ.

Mɔɔ Ebileham nyianle ɛvolɛ 99 la, Gyihova hanle kɛ: ‘Mebɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛbayɛ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo bɛ ze.’ Noko ɛnee kɛ ɛhye bazi ara nu, kɛmɔ ɛnee Ebileham nee Sɛla akee ɛnyi somaa kɛ bɛkɛwo ralɛ la ɛ?Mɔlebɛbo 11:27-32; 12:1-⁠7; 17:1-8, 15-17; 18:9-19. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ASOO ɛnwu mɔɔ Ebileham ɛlɛyɛ ye wɔ ɛke la ɔ? Ɔlɛ dadeɛ, na ɔzɔho kɛ ɔku ɔ ra ne. Duzu ati a ɔbayɛ ɛhye a? Mɔɔ lumua la, maa yɛnlea kɛ Ebileham nee Sɛla zi nyianle bɛ ra ne la.

Kakye kɛ, Nyamenle bɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛbawo ralɛ nrenya. Noko ɛnee ɔle kɛ asɛɛ ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ la, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ebileham nee Sɛla ɛnyi somaa. Noko akee, Ebileham liele lile kɛ Nyamenle bahola ayɛ mɔɔ le kɛ asɛɛ ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ la. Yemɔti boni a zile a?

Mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ ne wiele la, ɛvolɛ mumua pɛle nu. Na akee, mɔɔ Ebileham lile ɛvolɛ 100 na Sɛla noko ɛli ɛvolɛ 90 la, bɛwole ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ bɛvɛlɛle ye Ayezeke a. Nyamenle ɛli ye ɛwɔkɛ zo!

Noko mɔɔ Ayezeke nyinle la, Gyihova zɔle Ebileham diedi nleanle. Ɔvɛlɛle ye kɛ: ‘Ebileham!’ Na Ebileham liele zolɛ kɛ: ‘Mewɔ ɛke!’ Akee Nyamenle zele kɛ: ‘Fa ɛ ra nrenya ne, ɛ ra kokye ne, Ayezeke, na kɔ boka mɔɔ mebahile wɔ la azo. Kɔhu ye bɔ afɔle maa me wɔ ɛkɛ.’

Nea kɛzi zɔhane edwɛkɛ ne manle Ebileham arɛle bɔle a, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ebileham kulo ɔ ra ne kpalɛ kpalɛ. Na kakye kɛ, ɛnee Nyamenle ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ Ebileham abo zo amra badɛnla Keena azɛlɛ ne azo. Na saa Ayezeke wu a kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na ɛhye ara nu ɛ? Ɛnee Ebileham ɛnde ɛhye abo, noko akee ɔdiele Nyamenle.

Mɔɔ bɛdwule boka ne azo la, Ebileham kyekyele Ayezeke na ɔvale ye ɔdole afɔlemokyea ne mɔɔ yezi la azo. Akee ɔvale dadeɛ ne kɛ ɔku ɔ ra ne. Na ɛkɛ ne ala Nyamenle anwumabɔvolɛ deanle nu kɛ: ‘Ebileham, Ebileham!’ Na Ebileham liele zolɛ kɛ: ‘Mewɔ ɛke!’

Nyamenle zele kɛ: ‘Mmafa ɛ sa ɛka kakula ne anzɛɛ mmayɛ ye debie. Kɛkala menwu kɛ ɛlɛ me nu diedi, ɔboalekɛ wɔanva ɛ ra kokye ne wɔanyɛ me abokɛ.’

Nea diedi kpole mɔɔ Ebileham lɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle anu a! Ɔliele ɔlile kɛ debie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ Gyihova ɛngola ye yɛ a, na Gyihova bahola adwazo Ayezeke avi ewule nu bɔbɔ. Noko ɛnee tɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ kpalɛ a le kɛ Ebileham bahu Ayezeke. Yemɔti Nyamenle manle boane bie vindele kpɔkɛ bie mɔɔ bikye ɛkɛ ne la anu, na ɔmanle Ebileham gyakyile ɔ ra ne na ɔvale boane ne ɔbɔle afɔle.Mɔlebɛbo 21:1-⁠7; 22:1-18. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Lɔɔto Aye Ne Dole Ɔ Nye Ɔ Nzi
data.contenido:
LƆƆTO nee ye abusua ne dɛnlanle Ebileham anwo wɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo. Kenle ko Ebileham zele Lɔɔto kɛ: ‘Azɛlɛ ne ɛnza yɛ nyɛmoa ne mɔ. Mesɛlɛ wɔ, te ɛ nwo. Saa ɛkɔ bɛne zo a, mebahɔ fema zo.’

Lɔɔto dole ɔ nye nleanle azɛlɛ ne. Ɔnwunle maanle ne anu azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma kpalɛ bie mɔɔ lɛ nzule dɔɔnwo nee ndile kpalɛ mɔɔ ye nyɛmoa ne mɔ bali a. Ɛhye wɔ Dwɔdan Maanzinli ne anu. Yemɔti Lɔɔto vale ye abusua ne nee ye nyɛmoa ne mɔ hɔle ɛkɛ. Akee bɛhɔkyekyele bɛ aako wɔ Sodɔm.

Ɛnee menli mɔɔ wɔ Sodɔm la ɛbɛla ɛzɛkye kpalɛ. Ɛhye gyegyele Lɔɔto, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔle sonla kpalɛ. Nyamenle noko akunlu andwo nwolɛ. Awieleɛ kolaa ne, Nyamenle zoanle anwumabɔvolɛma nwiɔ kɛ bɛhɔbɔ Lɔɔto kɔkɔ kɛ ɔlɛba yearazɛkye Sodɔm nee suakpole Gɔmɔla mɔɔ bikye ye la ɔlua bɛ ninyɛndane ne ati.

Anwumabɔvolɛ ne mɔ hanle hilele Lɔɔto kɛ: ‘Ka ɛ nwo! Fa ɛ ye nee ɛ mra mraalɛ nwiɔ ne na nriandi fi ɛke!’ Lɔɔto nee ye abusua ne hwehwenle bɛ bo aze, yemɔti anwumabɔvolɛ ne mɔ zɔle bɛ sa na bɛ nee bɛ rale suakpole ne kandiba. Akee anwumabɔvolɛ ne mɔ anu ko zele kɛ: ‘Bɛnriandi bɛlie bɛ ngoane! Bɛmmato bɛ nye bɛ nzi. Bɛnriandi bɛhɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu.’ Lɔɔto nee ɔ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ diele na bɛnriandile bɛvile Sodɔm. Bɛangyinla ekyii bɔbɔ, yɛɛ bɛando bɛ nye bɛ nzi. Noko Lɔɔto aye ne andie. Bɛvile Sodɔm bɛhɔle ekyii la, ɔgyinlanle na ɔdole ɔ nye ɔ nzi. Na Lɔɔto aye ne hakyile ngyenle pila. Ɛnwu ye wɔ nvoninli ne anu ɔ?

Yɛbahola yɛazukoa debie kpalɛ yɛavi ɛhye anu. Ɔmaa yɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie ye la ngoane, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛndie ye la ngoane babɔ bɛ.Mɔlebɛbo 13:5-13; 18:20-33; 19:1-29; Luku 17:28-32; 2 Pita 2:6-⁠8. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ƐZE raalɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ wɔ nvoninli ɛhye anu la ɔ? Ye duma a le Relɛbɛka. Na nrenya ne mɔɔ ɔlɛba yearayia ye la a le Ayezeke. Ɔlɛba yearayɛ ɔ ye. Kɛzi ɛhye rale ɛ?

Ɛnee Ayezeke ɔ ze Ebileham kpondɛ kɛ ɔnyia yelɛ kpalɛ ɔmaa ɔ ra nrenya ne. Ɛnee ɔmkpondɛ kɛ Ayezeke gya Keena mraalɛ ne mɔ bie, ɔluakɛ ɛnee menli ɛhye mɔ sonle awozonle. Ɔti Ebileham vɛlɛle ye sonvolɛ ne na ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Mekpondɛ kɛ ɛsia ɛkɔ me nwo amra anu wɔ Hɛlan na ɛgya raalɛ ɛmaa me ra Ayezeke.’

Ɛkɛ ne ala Ebileham sonvolɛ ne vale afunlumu bulu na ɔzile nu ɔdule adenle tendendenlenle ne. Mɔɔ ɔbikyele ɛleka mɔɔ Ebileham anwo amra ne wɔ la, ɔgyinlanle bula bie anwo. Ɛnee aleɛ ɛlɛdwo, na ɛnee ɔle mekɛ mɔɔ mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la fa bato nzule fi bula ne anu a. Yemɔti Ebileham sonvolɛ ne yɛle nzɛlɛlɛ zele Gyihova kɛ: ‘Maa bɛlɛra ne mɔɔ kɛmaa me nzule ne bie kɛnlo na ɔkɛmaa afunlumu ne mɔ bie bɛkɛnlo la ɛyɛ sonla ne mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye ye kɛ ɔyɛ Ayezeke aye la.’

Yeangyɛ biala Relɛbɛka rale kɛ ɔbaza nzule. Mɔɔ sonvolɛ ne zɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔmaa ye nzule ɔnlo la, ɔmanle ye bie. Na akee ɔhɔzale nzule ne bie ɔrɛlɛle afunlumu ne mɔ mɔɔ nzuhɔne ɛlɛku bɛ la amuala ɔmanle ɔzale bɛ. Ɛnee ɛhye ɛnle gyima ekyi ɔluakɛ afunlumu no nzule dɔɔnwo kpalɛ.

Mɔɔ Relɛbɛka yɛle ɛhye wiele la, Ebileham sonvolɛ ne bizale ye ɔ ze duma. Eza ɔbizale saa ɔbahola yeazokoɛ bɛ sua nu nɔsolɛ ne a. Ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Me ze a le Bɛtuwɛle, na yɛlɛ sua mɔɔ ɛbazokoɛ nu a.’ Ɛnee Ebileham sonvolɛ ne ze ye kɛ Ebileham adiema nrenya Neehɔ ara a le Bɛtuwɛle. Yemɔti ɔhotole na ɔlale Gyihova ase kɛ yeva ye yera Ebileham anwo amra sua nu la.

Kenle ko nɔe ne Ebileham sonvolɛ ne hanle deɛ mɔɔ ɔti yera la ɔhilele Bɛtuwɛle yɛɛ Relɛbɛka adiema nrenya Leeban. Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛliele bɛdole nuhua kɛ ɔbahola ɔ nee Relɛbɛka ahɔ na yeahɔyɛ Ayezeke aye. Mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele Relɛbɛka la boni a ɔhanle a? Ɔbuale kɛ, ‘Ɛhɛe,’ ɔkulo kɛ ɔ nee ye kɛhɔ. Yemɔti aleɛ hyenle ala la bɛvole afunlumu ne mɔ azo na bɛbɔle adenle tendendenlenle ne abo kɛ bɛsia bɛahɔ Keena.

Bɛhɔdwule la ɛnee aleɛ ɛlɛdwo. Relɛbɛka nwunle kɛ nrenya bie luolua ɛya ne anu. Ɛnee Ayezeke ɔ. Ɔnwunle Relɛbɛka la ɔ nye liele. Ɛnee ɔ nli Sɛla wule la yenyia ɛvolɛ nsa pɛ, na ɛnee ɔtɛdi nwolɛ nyane. Noko, akee Ayezeke rahulole Relɛbɛka kpole kpalɛ, na ɔ nye liele bieko.Mɔlebɛbo 24:1-67. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NGAKULA mrenya nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la le ngakyile, ɔnle zɔ ɔ? Asoo ɛze bɛ aluma? Yisɔ a le bɔvolɛ ne, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛnea mboane ne mɔ la a le Gyekɔbo.

Ayezeke nee Relɛbɛka amra ndalɛ a le Yisɔ nee Gyekɔbo. Ɛnee bɛ ze Ayezeke kulo Yisɔ kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔle bɔvolɛ kpalɛ na ɛnee ɔfa aleɛ ɔba sua nu ɔmaa abusua ne nyia bie di. Noko Relɛbɛka hulole Gyekɔbo kpole kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔle kakula mɔɔ le bɛtɛɛ na ɔ nwo dwo a.



Ɛnee nenya Ebileham tɛte aze, na yɛkola yɛnwu kɛzi Gyekɔbo anye balie kɛ ɔkɛhɔ ye ɛkɛ ɔkɛhɔdie Gyihova anwo edwɛkɛ a. Akee Ebileham nyianle ɛvolɛ 175 la ɔwule, na ɛnee ndalɛ ne mɔ ɛnyia ɛvolɛ 15.

Mɔɔ Yisɔ nyianle ɛvolɛ 40 la ɔgyale mraalɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ vi Keena la. Ɛhye manle Ayezeke nee Relɛbɛka lile nyane, ɔluakɛ mraalɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛnzonle Gyihova.

Na kenle ko, debie bie zile mɔɔ manle Yisɔ vale ɔ diema Gyekɔbo anwo ɛya kpole kpalɛ a. Mekɛ dwule mɔɔ ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ Ayezeke yila ɔ ra kpanyinli ne a. Kɛmɔ Yisɔ tɛla Gyekɔbo kpanyinli la, ɛnee Yisɔ anye la kɛ ɔbanyia nyilalɛ ɛhye. Noko ɛnee Yisɔ ɛlumua ɛdɔne adenle mɔɔ ɔlɛ kɛ ɔnyia nyilalɛ ne la yemaa Gyekɔbo. Bieko, mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwole ngakula nwiɔ ne la ɛnee Nyamenle ɛha kɛ Gyekɔbo a banyia nyilalɛ ne a. Na ɛhye a ralɛ nu a. Ayezeke vale nyilalɛ ne manle ɔ ra Gyekɔbo.

Amozii, mɔɔ Yisɔ dele ɛhye la ɔvale Gyekɔbo anwo ɛya. Ɔvale ɛya dedee ɔhanle kɛ ɔkɔ yeahɔhu Gyekɔbo. Relɛbɛka dele ɛhye anwo bie la, ɔ rɛle bɔle. Ɔti ɔzele ɔ hu Ayezeke kɛ: ‘Ɔnrɛyɛ kpalɛ fee kɛ Gyekɔbo noko kɛgya Keena mraalɛ ne mɔ bie.’

Ɔlua ɛhye azo Ayezeke vɛlɛle ɔ ra nrenya Gyekɔbo na ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Mmagya Keena mraalɛ ne mɔ bie. Emomu kɔ Hɛlan, wɔ nenya Bɛtuwɛle sua nu. Kɔgya ɔ ra nrenya Leeban amra mraalɛ ne mɔ bie.’

Gyekɔbo diele ɔ ze, na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔbɔle ye adenle tendendenlenle ne abo ɔhɔle Hɛlan, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔ nwo amra ne de la.Mɔlebɛbo 25:5-11, 20-34; 26:34, 35; 27:1-46; 28:1-⁠5; Hibuluma 12:16, 17. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ASOO ɛze menli mɔɔ Gyekɔbo nee bɛ ɛlɛtendɛ la ɔ? Mɔɔ ɛnee Gyekɔbo ɛva mekɛ tendenle ɛdu adenle la, ɔyiale bɛ wɔ bula bie azo. Ɛnee bɛlɛnea bɛ mboane. Gyekɔbo bizale bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛvi ni?’

Bɛbuale kɛ: ‘Yɛvi Hɛlan.’

Gyekɔbo bizale kɛ: ‘Bɛze Leeban ɔ?’

Bɛyele ɔ nloa kɛ: ‘Ɛhɛe. Nea, ɔ ra raalɛ Relahyɛle a nee ye mboane ne mɔ ɛlɛba la.’ Asoo ɛnwu Relahyɛle wɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔvi moamoa nehane ɔlɛba? Mɔɔ Gyekɔbo nwunle Relahyɛle nee ɔ wuvuanyi Leeban mboane ne mɔ la, ɔhɔle ɔhɔhundole bolɛ ne ɔyele ye wɔ bula ne azo amaa mboane ne mɔ ahola nzule ne bie no. Akee Gyekɔbo vole Relahyɛle anvoka anwo na ɔhanle sonla holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔde la ɔhilele ye. Ɔ nye liele kpalɛ, na ɔhɔle sua nu na ɔhanle ɔhilele ɔ ze Leeban.

Leeban anye liele kɛ Gyekɔbo radɛnlanle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne la. Na mekɛ mɔɔ Gyekɔbo hanle kɛ ɔbagya Relahyɛle la, Leeban anye liele. Noko akee, ɔzele Gyekɔbo kɛ ɔyɛ gyima wɔ ye egyinli ne anu ɛvolɛ nsuu na yeagya Relahyɛle. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Gyekɔbo kulo Relahyɛle kpole kpalɛ la ati ɔyɛle ɛhye. Noko agyalɛ mekɛ ne dwule la, ɛze mɔɔ zile a?

Leeban anva Relahyɛle ammaa Gyekɔbo, emomu ɔvale ɔ ra raalɛ kpanyinli Liya a ɔmanle ye a. Mɔɔ Gyekɔbo liele dole nuhua kɛ ɔbazonle Leeban ɛvolɛ nsuu bieko la, Leeban eza vale Relahyɛle manle ye kɛ ɔ ye. Zɔhane mekɛ ne ɛnee Nyamenle maa adenle maa mrenya gya mraalɛ dɔɔnwo. Noko kɛkala, kɛmɔ Baebolo ne kile la, ɔwɔ kɛ nrenya biala aye yɛ ko pɛ.Mɔlebɛbo 29:1-30. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

WƆMƆ nea abusua kpole ɛhye. Gyekɔbo amra mrenya 12 ne mɔ ɛne. Na ɛnee ɔlɛ mralɛ mraalɛ noko. Asoo ɛze ngakula ne mɔ bie duma ɔ? Maa yɛzukoa bie mɔ.

Liya wole Wulubɛn, Semɛyɔn, Livae nee Dwuda. Mɔɔ Relahyɛle nwunle kɛ ɔtɛwole ralɛ biala la, ɔ rɛle bɔle. Yemɔti ɔvale ye sonvolɛ raalɛ Belehaa ɔmanle Gyekɔbo, na Belehaa wole mralɛ mrenya nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Dan yɛɛ Nafetalae. Akee Liya noko vale ye sonvolɛ raalɛ Zelepa manle Gyekɔbo, na Zelepa wole Gaade nee Ahya. Akee eza Liya wole mralɛ mrenya nwiɔ bieko, Yesakaa nee Zɛbulɛn.

Ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, Relahyɛle rawole ralɛ. Ɔdonle ye duma Dwosefi. Yɛbazukoa Dwosefi anwo ninyɛne dɔɔnwo amozii, ɔluakɛ ɔrayɛle sonla kpole mɔɔ anwo hyia a. Gyekɔbo amra 11 ne mɔɔ ɔnyianle bɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee Relahyɛle ɔ ze Leeban dɛnlanle la a le ɛhye mɔ.

Gyekɔbo eza nyianle mralɛ mraalɛ, noko Baebolo ne bɔ bɛ nuhua kokye ala duma. Ye duma a le Daena.

Mekɛ bie rale mɔɔ Gyekɔbo bɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔfi Leeban anwo yeazia yeahɔ Keena a. Yemɔti ɔboɔboale ye abusua kpole ne nee ye mboane ekpunli dɔɔnwo ne yɛɛ ye nlankɛ ne mɔ anloa na ɔbɔle adenle tendendenlenle ne abo.

Gyekɔbo nee ye abusua ne ziale rale Keena na ɔhyɛle ekyii la, Relahyɛle wole ralɛ nrenya bieko. Ɛhye zile mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ adendulɛ nu la. Relahyɛle awolɛ nu yɛle se kpalɛ, na ɔkawo yeawie la yɛɛ ɔwule a. Noko debie biala anyɛ adɔma ekyi ne mɔɔ ɛnee le nrenya la. Gyekɔbo donle ye duma Bɛngyaman.

Yɛkpondɛ kɛ yɛkakye Gyekɔbo amra mrenya 12 ne aluma ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛ maanle ne amuala vi bɛ nu a rale a. Nɔhalɛ nu, bɛvale Gyekɔbo amra mrenya 10 yɛɛ Dwosefi amra mrenya nwiɔ aluma a bɛdonle Yizilayɛ mbusua 12 ne a. Ayezeke dɛnlanle aze hyɛle ekyii wɔ ngakula mrenya ɛhye mɔ amuala awolɛ nzi, na ɔbayɛ kɛ ɔ nye liele kɛ ɔnyianle nlɔnra dɔɔnwo zɔhane la. Noko maa yɛnlea mɔɔ dole ye alɔnra raalɛ Daena la.Mɔlebɛbo 29:32-35; 30:1-26; 35:16-19; 37:35. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ASOO ɛze menli mɔɔ Daena ɛlɛkɔ ahɔkpɔla bɛ la? Ɔlɛkɔ ngakula mraalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛde Keena azɛlɛ ne azo la ɛkɛ. Asoo ɔ ze Gyekɔbo anye balie ɛhye anwo ɔ? Amaa wɔaye edwɛkɛ ɛhye anloa la, kakye mɔɔ Ebileham nee Ayezeke zuzule ye wɔ Keena mraalɛ ne mɔ anwo la. Asoo ɛnee Ebileham kpondɛ kɛ ɔ ra Ayezeke gya Keena kakula raalɛ ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, yeamkpondɛ ye zɔ. Asoo ɛnee Ayezeke nee Relɛbɛka kpondɛ kɛ bɛ ra Gyekɔbo gya Keena kakula raalɛ? Kyɛkyɛ, bɛangulo ye zɔ. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔrale ye zɔ la ɔ?

Ɔrale ye zɔ ɔluakɛ menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Keena la ɛnee sonle awozonle. Ɛnee bɛnle menli mgbalɛ mɔɔ fɛta kɛ bɛ nee bɛ tɛnla kɛ kunlima nee yelɛma a, na ɛnee bɛnle menli mgbalɛ mɔɔ fɛta kɛ bɛfa bɛ agɔnwolɛ a. Ɔti yɛkola yɛnwu ye wienyi kɛ ɛnee Gyekɔbo anye ɛnrɛlie nwolɛ kɛ ɔ ra raalɛ ne ɛlɛfa Keena ngakula mraalɛ ɛhye mɔ agɔnwolɛ a.

Amgba noko, edwɛkɛ dole Daena. Ɛnwu Keenanli kpavolɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ nvoninli ne anu mɔɔ ɛlɛnea Daena la ɔ? Bɛfɛlɛ ye Hyikɛm. Kenle ko Daena hɔle kɛ ɔkakpɔla ɔ gɔnwo mɔ la, Hyikɛm hyele Daena mialera nu ɔ nee ye lale. Ɛhye le ɛtane, ɔluakɛ agyalɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ nee bɛ nwo da a. Ɛtane ɛhye mɔɔ Hyikɛm yɛle Daena la vale ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo rale.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Daena amediema mrenya ne mɔ dele mɔɔ ɛzi la, bɛvale ɛya kpole. Bɛ nuhua nwiɔ, Semɛyɔn nee Livae, vale ɛya dedee na bɛvale dadeɛ bɛhɔle mrenya ne mɔ anwo zo wɔ suakpole ne azo arɛlevilɛ nu. Bɛ nee bɛ mediema mrenya ne mɔ hunle Hyikɛm nee mrenya mɔɔ ɛha la amuala. Gyekɔbo vale ɛya wɔ ɛtane ɛhye mɔɔ ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ yɛle la anwo.

Kɛ ngyegyelɛ ɛhye amuala zile bɔle ɔ bo ɛ? Ɔrale ye zɔ ɔluakɛ Daena vale menli mɔɔ bulu Nyamenle mɛla zo la agɔnwolɛ la ati ɔ. Yɛnrɛhulo kɛ yɛkɛva agɔnwolɛ zɛhae bie, ɔnle zɔ ɔ?Mɔlebɛbo 34:1-31. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Dwosefi Amediema Ne Mɔ Kpɔle Ye
data.contenido:
NEA kɛzi kakula ne anwo ɛyɛ alɔbɔlɛ bie ɛ. Dwosefi ɛne. Kɛkala a ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ ɛdɔne ye ɛmaa mrenya ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ agyakɛ wɔ zo ɛlɛkɔ Yigyibiti la. Dwosefi kayɛ akɛlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ. Duzu ati a ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ ɛyɛ debie ɛtane ɛhye a? Ɔluakɛ bɛngulo Dwosefi edwɛkɛ la ati ɔ.

Ɛnee bɛ ze Gyekɔbo kulo Dwosefi edwɛkɛ kpalɛ. Ɔhulole ye edwɛkɛ ɔdɛlale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛha la ɔlua tɛladeɛ tendenle kɛnlɛma bie mɔɔ ɔkpomgbale ɔmanle ye la azo. Na mɔɔ ɔ mediema mrenya mgbanyinli 10 ne nwunle kɛ Gyekɔbo kulo Dwosefi edwɛkɛ tɛla bɛ la, bɛangulo Dwosefi edwɛkɛ na bɛkpɔle ye. Noko debie bieko wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔti bɛkpɔle ye a.

Dwosefi hanle ɛlalɛ nwiɔ. Wɔ Dwosefi ɛlalɛ ne amu nwiɔ anu, ɔ mediema ne mɔ bɔle bɛ ti aze manle ye. Mekɛ mɔɔ Dwosefi hanle ɛlalɛ ɛhye mɔ hilele ɔ mediema ne mɔ la, bɛ ɛkpɔlɛ ne akee yɛle kpole kpalɛ.

Kenle ko, mekɛ mɔɔ Dwosefi amediema mrenya mgbanyinli ne mɔ vale bɛ ze mboane ne mɔ hɔle adidi la, Gyekɔbo zoanle Dwosefi kɛ ɔhɔnlea saa ɔ mediema ne mɔ anwo le kpalɛ a. Mɔɔ Dwosefi amediema ne mɔ nwunle kɛ ɔlɛba la, bie mɔ hanle kɛ: ‘Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛhu ye!’ Noko Wulubɛn, zele kɛ: ‘Kyɛkyɛ, bɛmmaku ye!’ Emomu bɛhyele Dwosefi na bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole kuma bie mɔɔ nzule ɛnle nuhua la anu. Akee bɛdɛnlanle aze kɛ bɛdwenledwenle mɔɔ bɛbayɛ ye la anwo. Mekɛ ɛhye anu bɛnwunle kɛ Yehyemeeyɛlema bie ɛlɛba. Dwuda zele ɔ ze amra ne mɔ kɛ: ‘Bɛmaa yɛdɔne ye yɛmaa Yehyemeeyɛlema ne mɔ.’ Na zɔhane ala a bɛyɛle a. Bɛdɔnenle Dwosefi dwɛtɛ fufule 20. Nea angomedi nee atisesebɛ mɔɔ ɛhye kile a!

Duzu a ɔ mediema ne mɔ baha ahile bɛ ze a? Bɛhunle abɔnkye ko na bɛvale Dwosefi tɛladeɛ kɛnlɛma ne bɛfofɔle abɔnkye ne mogya ne. Akee bɛvale tɛladeɛ ne bɛhɔle sua nu bɛvale bɛmanle bɛ ze Gyekɔbo na bɛzele kɛ: ‘Debie mɔɔ yɛnwu ye la ɛne. Nea saa Dwosefi tɛladeɛ ne a.’

Gyekɔbo nwunle kɛ yemɔ ɔ. Ɔdeanle nuhua kɛ: ‘Nane anwo ɛzulolɛ bie ɛhu Dwosefi.’ Na zɔhane ala a ɛnee Dwosefi amediema ne mɔ kpondɛ kɛ bɛ ze dwenle a. Gyekɔbo lile nyane kpole kpalɛ. Ɔzunle mekɛ dɔɔnwo. Noko ɛnee Dwosefi ɛtɛwule. Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ dole ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛvale ye bɛhɔle la.Mɔlebɛbo 37:1-35. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MEKƐ mɔɔ bɛvale Dwosefi bɛhɔle Yigyibiti la ɛnee yenyia ɛvolɛ 17 pɛ. Bɛdɔnenle ye bɛmanle nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Pɔtefaa la wɔ ɛkɛ. Ɛnee Pɔtefaa yɛ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Falo la gyima.

Dwosefi yelele ɔ nwo kpalɛ yɛle gyima manle ɔ menle Pɔtefaa. Yemɔti mekɛ mɔɔ Dwosefi nyinle la, Pɔtefaa vale ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne debie biala wulale ɔ sa nu. Ɛnee, akee, duzu ati a Dwosefi la efiade ɛke a? Ɔlua Pɔtefaa aye ne anwo zo a ɛmaa yera ye zɔ a.

Dwosefi nyinle rayɛle nrenya kɛnlɛma kpalɛ, na ɛnee Pɔtefaa aye ne kpondɛ kɛ ɔ nee ye da. Noko ɛnee Dwosefi ze kɛ ɛhye le ɛtane, ɔti yeanyɛ. Pɔtefaa aye ne vale ɛya kpole. Yemɔti mɔɔ ɔ hu rale la, ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Wɔ sonvolɛ ɛtane ne, Dwosefi, kpondɛ kɛ ɔ nee me da!’ Pɔtefaa liele ɔ ye lile, na ɔvale Dwosefi anwo ɛya kpalɛ. Ɔti ɔmanle bɛvale ye bɛdole efiade.

Yeangyɛ biala nrenya ne mɔɔ nea efiade ne azo la nwunle ye kɛ Dwosefi le sonla kpalɛ. Yemɔti ɔvale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ efiade ɛkɛ ne la amuala ɔwulale ɔ sa nu. Nzinlii Falo vale ye sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ nea nza zo nee mɔɔ to kpanwo la anwo ɛya, na ɔvale bɛ ɔguale efiade. Kenle ko nɔɔzo, bɛ nuhua ko biala hanle ɛlalɛ ngakyile bie, noko ɛnee bɛnde mɔɔ ɛlalɛ ne kile la abo. Aleɛ hyenle la Dwosefi zele kɛ: ‘Bɛha bɛ ɛlalɛ ne mɔ bɛhile me.’ Na bɛhanle la, Nyamenle boale Dwosefi, manle ɔhilele bɛ ɛlalɛ ne mɔ abo.

Dwosefi zele sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ nea nza zo la kɛ: ‘Ɛnɛ anwo zo kenle nsa bɛbaraye wɔ wɔ efiade ɛke, na ɛbazia wɔayɛ Falo nza zo neavolɛ bieko.’ Yemɔti Dwosefi hanle zɔle zolɛ kɛ: ‘Saa bɛye wɔ a, bɔ me duma kile Falo, na boa maa ɔye me ɔvi ɛke.’ Na sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ to kpanwo la ɛdeɛ, Dwosefi zele ye kɛ: ‘Ɛnɛ anwo zo kenle nsa Falo bamaa bɛapɛ ɛ ti.’

Ye kenle nsa ne azo ɔzile kɛmɔ Dwosefi hanle ye la ala. Falo manle bɛpɛle sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ to kpanwo ne la ati. Sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ nea nza zo la ɛdeɛ, bɛyele ye bɛvile efiade na ɔbɔle ɔ bo ɔzonlenle belemgbunli ne bieko. Noko nza zo neavolɛ ne angakye Dwosefi! Yeambɔ ye duma yeangile Falo, na Dwosefi hɔle zo lale efiade.Mɔlebɛbo 39:1-23; 40:1-23. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ƐVOLƐ nwiɔ ɛze ɛhɔ, na Dwosefi tɛda efiade. Sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ nea nza zo la ɛtɛkakyele ye. Na kenle ko nɔɔzo Falo hanle ɛlalɛ ɛzulolɛ nwiɔ, na ɛnee ɔnde mɔɔ bɛkile la abo. Asoo ɛnwu ye kɛ ɔla ɛkɛ ne ɔ? Aleɛ hyenle la Falo vɛlɛvɛlɛle ye nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne na ɔhanle ye ɛlalɛ ne mɔ ɔhile bɛ. Noko bɛangola bɛangile ye ɛlalɛ ne mɔ abo bɛangile ye.

Akee sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ nea nza zo la hakyele Dwosefi. Ɔzele Falo kɛ: ‘Mekɛ mɔɔ mela efiade la ɛnee nrenya bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ kola kile ɛlalɛ bo a.’ Ɛkɛ ne ala Falo manle bɛyele Dwosefi bɛvile efiade bɛrale. Falo hanle ye ɛlalɛ ne mɔ hilele Dwosefi: ‘Menwunle nlankɛ mgbole, dɔlera nsuu. Na akee menwunle nlankɛ nwanlera, kengamgbaanwo nsuu noko. Na nwanlera ne mɔ hyele nlankɛ mgbole ne mɔ lile.

‘Wɔ me ɛlalɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ la anu, menwunle abɛlɛ mbaka mgbole nsuu mɔɔ ɛwɔlɔwɔlɔ baka ko anwo. Na akee menwunle abɛlɛ mbaka ɛtane ɛtane, mɔɔ aleɛ ɛnle nu la nsuu mɔɔ ɔdaye noko yewɔlɔ. Na abɛlɛ mbaka ɛtane ɛtane ne mɔ memenle abɛlɛ mgbole ne mɔ.’ Dwosefi buale Falo kɛ: ‘Ɛlalɛ nwiɔ ne abo le kokye. Nlankɛ mgbole nsuu ne nee abɛlɛ mbaka mgbole nsuu ne kile ɛvolɛ nsuu, yɛɛ nlankɛ nwanlera nsuu ne nee abɛlɛ mbaka ɛtane ɛtane nsuu ne kile ɛvolɛ nsuu bieko. Ɛvolɛ nsuu bara mɔɔ aleɛ babu kpole wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ ye azo a. Akee ɛvolɛ nsuu badoa zo mɔɔ ɛhɔne kpole kpalɛ bara a.’

Yemɔti Dwosefi hanle hilele Falo kɛ: ‘Ye sonla mɔɔ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo na ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ, na maa ɔnlea aleɛ ɛboɔboalɛ zo wɔ ɛvolɛ kpalɛ ne mɔ anu. Amaa saa ɛvolɛ nsuu ɛhɔne ne mɔɔ doa ye la ba a, ɛhɔne angu menli ne ambɔ bɛ bo zo.’

Nzuzulɛ ne zɔle Falo anye. Na ɔyele Dwosefi kɛ ɔboɔboa aleɛ nloa, na ɔva ɔzie. Dwosefi rayɛle sonla kpole mɔɔ anwo hyia la wɔ Yigyibiti mɔɔ saa Falo ɛnle ɛkɛ a ɔdaye a ɔwɔ ɛkɛ a.

Ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ anzi, wɔ ɛhɔne mekɛ ne anu, Dwosefi nwunle mrenya bie kɛ bɛlɛba. Ɛze bɛ menli holɛ ko ɔ? Ɔ mediema mgbanyinli 10 ne ɔ! Ɛnee bɛ ze Gyekɔbo ɛzoa bɛ wɔ Yigyibiti ɔluakɛ ɛnee aleɛ nwo ɛhyia wɔ bɛ sua zo Keena. Dwosefi nwunle ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ, noko bɛmɛ ɛdeɛ bɛannwu ye sonla holɛ. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti bɛannwu ye la ɔ? Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Dwosefi ɛyɛ kpanyinli, na yeziezie ɔ nwo ngakyile.

Dwosefi hakyele kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔle kakula la ɔhanle ɛlalɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ ɛlɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛamaa ye a. Ɛkakye kɛ wɔgenga ɛhye anwo debie ɔ? Ɔti Dwosefi nwunle ye kɛ Nyamenle a ɛzoa ye ɛmaa yera Yigyibiti a, na ɔlua adwenle kpalɛ bie azo ati ɔ. Duzu a ɛsuzu kɛ Dwosefi yɛle a? Maa yɛnlea.Mɔlebɛbo 41:1-57; 42:1-⁠8; 50:20. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Dwosefi Zɔle Ɔ Mediema Ne Mɔ Nleanle
data.contenido:
ƐNEE Dwosefi kpondɛ kɛ ɔnwu ye kɛ ɔ mediema mgbanyinli 10 ne tɛde angomedi na bɛ ti tɛyɛ se a. Ɔti ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Bɛle busiama. Bɛra kɛ bɛbanleɛnlea yɛ maanle ye anu bɛanwu ɛleka mɔɔ yɛtɔ sinli la.’

Bɛbuale kɛ: ‘Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane. Nɔhalɛ a yɛka a. Yɛ muala yɛ ze ko. Ɛnee yɛle mediema 12. Na yɛ nuhua ko ɛnle ɛkɛ bieko, yɛɛ nuhua kazima ne wɔ yɛ ze anwo lɔ wɔ sua nu.’

Dwosefi anye fuu yɛle kɛ ɔnlie bɛ ɔnli la. Ɔhyele bɛ diema nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Semɛyɔn la ɔdole efiade, na ɔmanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la vale aleɛ hɔle sua nu. Noko ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ: ‘Saa bɛsia bɛara a, ɛnee bɛva bɛ diema nrenya ekyi ne bɛrɛla.’

Bɛdwule sua nu wɔ Keena la, mediema ne mɔ hanle mɔɔ zile bɛ nwo zo la amuala hilele bɛ ze Gyekɔbo. Gyekɔbo arɛle bɔle kpole. Ɔzele kɛ: ‘Dwosefi ɛnle ɛkɛ bieko, na Semɛyɔn ɛvi me sa. Menrɛmaa bɛnrɛva Bɛngyaman, me ra ekyi ne bɛnrɛhɔ.’ Noko mɔɔ bɛ aleɛ ne ɛlɛwie la, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ Gyekɔbo maa bɛfa Bɛngyaman bɛkɔ Yigyibiti ala amaa bɛanyia aleɛ ne bie.

Dwosefi nwunle kɛ ɔ mediema ne mɔ ɛlɛba. Ɔ nye liele kpalɛ kɛ ɔnwunle ɔ diema kakula Bɛngyaman a. Nɔhalɛ nu, ɛnee bɛ biala ɛnze kɛ Dwosefi a le sonla kpole ɛhye a. Akee Dwosefi yɛle debie vale zɔle ɔ ze amra 10 ne nleanle.

Ɔmanle ye sonvolɛma ne vale aleɛ wulowulale bɛ ahodoku ne mɔ anu. Noko ɔmanle bɛvale ye dwɛtɛ fufule kɔpo ne bɛwulale Bɛngyaman kodoku ɛdeɛ ne anu, mɔɔ awie biala annwu ye a. Mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛvile suakpole ne azo bɛyele bɛ nwo na bɛhɔle moa ekyii la, Dwosefi zoanle ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ manle bɛdoale bɛ. Mɔɔ bɛhɔdole bɛ la, sonvolɛma ne mɔ bizale kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a bɛwua yɛ menle dwɛtɛ fufule kɔpo ne ɛ?’

Mediema ne mɔ amuala hanle kɛ: ‘Yɛtɛwuale ye kɔpo. Yɛ nuhua ko biala mɔɔ ɛkɛnwu kɔpo ne wɔ ye ɛkɛ ne la, maa bɛhu ye.’

Yemɔti sonvolɛma ne mɔ nleɛnleanle bɛ ahodoku ne mɔ anu, na bɛnwunle kɔpo ne wɔ Bɛngyaman kodoku ɛdeɛ ne anu, kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke la. Sonvolɛma ne zele kɛ: ‘Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la kola sia kɔ, na Bɛngyaman mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ nee ye kɔ.’ Duzu a ɔ ze amra 10 ne bayɛ ye kɛkala a?

Bɛ muala bɛ nee Bɛngyaman ziale hɔle Dwosefi sua nu. Dwosefi hanle kɛ: ‘Bɛ muala bɛkola bɛkɔ sua nu, na Bɛngyaman ɛdeɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔtɛnla ɛke kɛ me akɛlɛ.’

Akee Dwuda dendɛle, na ɔzele kɛ: ‘Saa mesia mekɔ sua nu mɔɔ kakula ne ɛmboka nwo a, me ze bawu ɔluakɛ ɔkulo kakula ne somaa. Yemɔti mebodo mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa wɔ sonvolɛ, menga ɛke kɛ wɔ akɛlɛ, na maa kakula ne ɛhɔ sua nu.’

Dwosefi nwunle ye kɛ ɔ mediema ne mɔ ɛhakyi. Bɛnle angomedi nee abolɛ bieko. Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ akee Dwosefi yɛle la.Mɔlebɛbo 42:9-38; 43:1-34; 44:1-34. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

DWOSEFI angola ɔ nwo sɔ bieko. Ɔmanle ye sonvolɛma ne amuala vi sua ne anu vindele. Mɔɔ ɔhale ɔ nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ angome la, Dwosefi zunle. Yɛkola yɛnwu kɛzi ɛhye zinle ɔ mediema ne mɔ anwo la, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛnze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔlɛsu la. Na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Medame a mele Dwosefi. Egya tɛte aze ɔ?’

Ɔzinle ɔ mediema ne mɔ anwo mɔɔ bɛangola bɛ nloa anu tɛ a. Bɛ ahonle dule. Noko Dwosefi zele kɛ: ‘Mebodo bɛ bɛbikye me.’ Mɔɔ bɛhwenle bɛbikyele ye la, ɔzele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛ diema Dwosefi, mɔɔ bɛdɔnenle ye bɛmanle bɛ nee ye hɔle Yigyibiti la a le me.’

Dwosefi hɔle zolɛ dendɛle adenle kɛnlɛma zo kɛ: ‘Bɛmmafa bɛ nwo ɛya kɛ bɛdɔnenle me bɛmanle bɛ nee me rale ɛke a. Nyamenle a zoanle me Yigyibiti kɛ membanlie menli ngoane a. Falo ɛva me ɛzie maanle ye kɔsɔɔti azo kpanyinli. Yemɔti bɛha bɛ nwo waa bɛhɔ egya ɛkɛ na bɛha ɛhye mɔ amuala bɛhile ye. Na bɛha bɛhile ye kɛ ɔrɛla ɔradɛnla ɛke.’

Akee Dwosefi vale ɔ sa ɔbɛkale ɔ mediema ne mɔ akɔme, ɔbetanle bɛ, na ɔvole bɛ muala bɛ nvoka anwo. Mɔɔ Falo dele kɛ Dwosefi amediema ne mɔ ɛra la, ɔzele Dwosefi kɛ: ‘Maa bɛva ehwili na bɛhɔva bɛ ze nee bɛ sua nu amra amuala bɛrɛla. Mebamaa bɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ tɛla biala wɔ Yigyibiti ɛke la meamaa bɛadɛnla zolɛ.’

Zɔhane ala a bɛyɛle a. Nea Dwosefi kɛ yehɔyia ɔ ze mɔɔ ɔ nee ye sua nu amra amuala ɛlɛba Yigyibiti la wɔ ɛke ɛ. Gyekɔbo abusua ne rayɛle kpole. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛba Yigyibiti la, ɛnee Gyekɔbo nee ɔ mra yɛɛ ye nlɔnra ne mɔ amuala le 70. Noko ɛnee bɛ ye mɔ, yɛɛ bie a, bɛ sonvolɛma dɔɔnwo noko boka nwolɛ. Ɛhye mɔ amuala radɛnlanle Yigyibiti. Bɛvɛlɛle bɛ Yizilayɛma, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛhakyi Gyekɔbo duma ɛyɛ ye Yizilayɛ. Yizilayɛma ne rayɛle maanle titile bie manle Nyamenle, kɛmɔ yɛbazukoa ye amozii la.Mɔlebɛbo 45:1-28; 46:1-27. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ASOO nrenya ɛhye mɔɔ ɛnde kpɔkɛ la anwo ɛnyɛ wɔ alɔbɔlɛ? Bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwobu, na ɔ ye a le raalɛ ne. Asoo ɛze edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛka yeahile Dwobu la ɔ? ‘Tendɛ tia Nyamenle na wu.’ Maa yɛnlea deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔhanle edwɛkɛ zɛhae, nee mɔɔ ɔti Dwobu nwunle amaneɛ kpole ɛhye la.

Dwobu le sonla mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ mɔɔ diele Gyihova a. Ɛnee ɔwɔ Ɛɛze azɛlɛ ne, mɔɔ bikye Keena la azo. Ɛnee Gyihova kulo Dwobu kpole kpalɛ, noko awie bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ kpɔ ye a. Ɛze ahenle holɛ ɔ?

Seetan Abɔnsam ɔ. Kakye kɛ Seetan a le anwumabɔvolɛ ɛtane ne mɔɔ kpɔ Gyihova la. Ɔholale ɔmanle Adam nee Yive yɛle Gyihova anwo anzosesebɛ, na ɛnee ɔdwenle kɛ ɔbahola yeamaa awie biala noko ayɛ Gyihova anwo anzosesebɛ. Na asoo ɔholale ɔyɛle zɔ? Kyɛkyɛ. Wɔmɔ nea mrenya nee mraalɛ nɔhavoma mɔɔ yɛzukoa bɛ nwo debie la. Nyɛ a ɛbahola wɔabobɔ bɛ aluma a?

Mɔɔ Gyekɔbo nee Dwosefi wule wɔ Yigyibiti la anzi, Dwobu a ɛnee le sonla mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ maa Gyihova wɔ azɛlɛ ne amuala azo a. Ɛnee Gyihova kpondɛ kɛ Seetan nwu ye kɛ ɔnrɛhola ɔnrɛmaa awie biala ɛnrɛyɛ ɛtane, yemɔti ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Wɔnwu Dwobu. Wɔnwu kɛzi ɔdi nɔhalɛ ɔmaa me la.’

Seetan buale kɛ: ‘Ɔdi nɔhalɛ, ɔluakɛ wɔyila ye yɛɛ ɔlɛ ninyɛne mgbalɛ dɔɔnwo. Na saa ɛdie ɛhye mɔ ɛfi ɔ sa nu a, ɔbadendɛ yeatietia wɔ.’

Yemɔti Gyihova zele kɛ: ‘Kɔ zolɛ. Die debie biala fi ɔ sa nu. Yɛ Dwobu debie biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la. Na nea saa ɔbadendɛ yeatia me a. Noko nea na wɔangu ye.’ Mɔɔ lumua la, Seetan manle menli wuale Dwobu nlankɛ nee ye afunlumu ne mɔ, na bɛhuhunle ye mboane ne mɔ. Akee ɔmanle ahumu dule hunle ɔ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ 10. Ɛhye anzi Seetan manle ewule ɛtane ɛhye bɔle Dwobu. Dwobu vɛle kpalɛ. Na yemɔti a ɔ ye zele ye kɛ: ‘Tendɛ tia Nyamenle na wu’ a. Noko Dwobu anyɛ zɔ ɛlɛ. Eza ɔ gɔnwo mɔ alane nsa bie rale razele ye kɛ yebɔ ɛbɛla ɛtane. Noko Dwobu hɔle zo lile nɔhalɛ.

Ɛhye manle Gyihova anye liele kpalɛ, na amozii ɔyilale Dwobu, kɛmɔ ɛkola ɛnwu ye wɔ nvoninli ye anu la. Ɔmanle ɔdele kpɔkɛ. Dwobu wole mralɛ 10 fofolɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ, na ɔnyianle ye nlankɛ, ye mboane nee ye afunlumu ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye dɛba la mɔnwo.

Asoo ɛbali nɔhalɛ wɔamaa Gyihova dahuu kɛ Dwobu? Saa ɛyɛ ye zɔ a, Nyamenle bayila ɛdawɔ noko. Ɛbahola wɔadɛnla aze dahuu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbayɛ azɛlɛ ye azo amuala kɛnlɛma kɛ Yidɛn tola ne ala la.Dwobu 1:1-22; 2:1-13; 42:10-17. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MRENYA ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛke la ɛlɛtinlitinli menli ne mɔ anwo zo bɛamaa bɛayɛ gyima. Nea nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛlɛfa empele ne agua gyimayɛvoma ne anu ko la! Gyimayɛvoma ne vi Gyekɔbo abusua nu, na bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Yizilayɛma. Na mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛmaa bɛayɛ gyima ne la le Yigyibitima. Yizilayɛma ɛrayɛ Yigyibitima ngɛkɛlɛ. Kɛ ɛhye zile rale ɛ?

Gyekɔbo abusua kpole ne dɛnlanle anzondwolɛ nu wɔ Yigyibiti wɔ ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo anu. Dwosefi mɔɔ ɛnee le sonla kpole mɔɔ anwo hyia wɔ Yigyibiti mɔɔ belemgbunli Falo ɛnle ɛkɛ a ɔdaye a ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne la, nleanle bɛ. Noko akee Dwosefi wule. Na Falo fofolɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔngulo Yizilayɛma ne la, rayɛle belemgbunli wɔ Yigyibiti.

Yemɔti Falo ati ɛsesebɛ ɛhye manle Yizilayɛma yɛle ngɛkɛlɛ. Na ɔmanle menli mɔɔ ati yɛ se na bɛnze anwunvɔne la nleanle bɛ nwo zo. Bɛhyele Yizilayɛma mialera nu bɛmanle bɛyɛle gyima mɔɔ bo bɛ nwo zo la bɛsisile azuamgbole bɛmanle Falo. Noko Yizilayɛma ne hɔle zolɛ yɛle dɔɔnwo. Mekɛ hɔle bie la Yigyibitima razulole kɛ Yizilayɛma ne barayɛ dɔɔnwo somaa na bayɛ maanle ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ. Ɔti ɛze mɔɔ Falo yɛle a? Ɔdendɛle ɔhilele mraalɛ mɔɔ die Yizilayɛ mraalɛ awolɛ la, na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Bɛhu adɔma biala mɔɔ le nrenya mɔɔ bɛkɛwo ye la.’ Noko ɛnee mraalɛ ɛhye mɔ le menli mgbalɛ, na bɛangu adɔma ne mɔ.

Na akee Falo yɛle mɛla ɛhye manle ye menli ne amuala kɛ: ‘Bɛhu Yizilayɛ adɔma biala mɔɔ le nrenya la. Adɔma mɔɔ le raalɛ la ala a bɛmmaku ye a.’ Asoo ɛhye ɛnle atisesebɛ mɛla ɔ? Maa yɛnlea kɛzi bɛliele ngakula mrenya adɔma ne mɔ anu ko la.Adendulɛ 1:6-22. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Kɛzi Bɛliele Adɔma Mosisi Ngoane La
data.contenido:
NEA kɛ kakula adɔma ne ɛlɛsu, na ɔlɛsɔ bɛlɛra ne asa ɛ. Mosisi ɛne. Asoo ɛze bɛlɛra kɛnlɛma ne sonla holɛ ɔ? Ɔle Yigyibiti belemgbunli ara raalɛ, Falo mumua ne ara raalɛ.

Mosisi ɔ nli vale ɔ ra adɔma ne ziele toonwo ɔnyianle siane nsa, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔmkpondɛ kɛ Yigyibitima ne ku ye. Noko ɛnee ɔze kɛ ɔbahola yeara ye kɛ bɛbanwu Mosisi, ɔti mɔɔ ɔyɛle ɔliele ye ngoane la ɛne.

Ɔvale kɛndɛne na ɔzieziele ye mɔɔ nzule ɛngola ɛngɔ nu a. Akee ɔvale Mosisi ɔdole nu, na ɔvale kɛndɛne ne ɔhɔziele ndile ne mɔɔ wɔ Azule Naele ne anloa la anu. Bɛmanle Mosisi adiema raalɛ, Meleam, gyinlanle moa ekyi nleanle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bazi la. Yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ Falo ara raalɛ ne hɔle Azule Naele ne anu kɛ ɔkabia a. Arɛlevilɛ nu ala ɔ nye hɔdɔle kɛndɛne ne azo kɛ ɔgyi ndile ne anu. Ɔzoanle ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ ko kɛ: ‘Kɔva kɛndɛne ne bɛlɛ me.’ Nea kakula adɔma kɛnlɛma ko mɔɔ belemgbunli ara raalɛ ne nwunle ye mekɛ mɔɔ ɔdukuele kɛndɛne ne azo la ɛ! Ɛnee kakula Mosisi ɛlɛsu, na belemgbunli ara raalɛ ne lile ɔ nwo nyane. Yeangulo kɛ ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛhu ye.

Akee Meleam vindele rale. Ɛkola ɛnwu ye wɔ nvoninli ne anu. Meleam bizale Falo ara raalɛ ne kɛ: ‘Mengɔnvɛlɛ Yizilayɛnli raalɛ memaa ɔrava kakula ne ɔhɔnlea ye ɔmaa wɔ ɔ?’

Belemgbunli ara raalɛ ne zele kɛ: ‘Ɛhɛe, kɔ.’

Yemɔti Meleam hanle ɔ nwo ndɛndɛ hɔvɛlɛle ɔ nli. Mɔɔ Mosisi ɔ nli rale la, belemgbunli ara raalɛ ne zele kɛ: ‘Fa kakula ɛhye kɔ kɔnlea ye maa me na mebadua wɔ kakɛ.’

Yemɔti Mosisi ɔ nli nleanle ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ ra. Nzinlii mɔɔ Mosisi nyinle la, ɔ nli vale ye hɔmanle Falo ara raalɛ ne, na ɔtetele ye kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ ra nrenya. Ɛhye azo a ɔlua mɔɔ Mosisi ranyinle wɔ Falo sua nu a.Adendulɛ 2:1-10. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Deɛ Mɔɔ Ɔti Mosisi Nriandile La
data.contenido:
NEA Mosisi mɔɔ ɛlɛnriandi avi Yigyibiti la. Ɛnwu mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛfoa ye la ɔ? Asoo ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛku Mosisi la? Maa yɛnlea saa yɛkɛnwu ye a.

Mosisi nyinle wɔ Falo, Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne sua nu. Ɔrayɛle sonla kpole mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ a. Ɛnee Mosisi ze ye kɛ ɔnle Yigyibitinli, na ye awovolɛma kpalɛ kpalɛ ne le Yizilayɛma mɔɔ le ngɛkɛlɛ a.

Kenle ko, mɔɔ ɛnee Mosisi ɛnyia ɛvolɛ 40 la, ɔyɛle kɛ ɔkanlea kɛ ye menli ne mɔ anwo de la. Ɛnee kɛzi bɛyɛ bɛ la ɛnle kpalɛ fee zɛhae. Ɔnwunle kɛ Yigyibitinli bie ɛlɛbo Yizilayɛ ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ anu ko. Mosisi totole ɔ nye na yeannwu awie biala kɛ ɔlɛnea ye la, ɔbɔle Yigyibitinli ne, na Yigyibitinli ne wule. Akee Mosisi vunle ye veale ɛnwea ne anu.

Aleɛ hyenle la Mosisi hɔle kɛ ɔkanlea ye menli ne bieko. Ɛnee ɔdwenle kɛ ɔbahola yeaboa bɛ na bɛangɔ zo bɛanyɛ ngɛkɛlɛ bieko. Noko ɔnwunle Yizilayɛma nwiɔ kɛ bɛlɛko, yemɔti Mosisi zele nuhua ne mɔɔ anyɛ ye boɛ la kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a ɛlɛbo ɛ gɔnwo ɛ?’

Nrenya ne buale kɛ: ‘Nwane a yɛle wɔ yɛ nwo zo neavolɛ nee ndɛnebuavolɛ a? Ɛkpondɛ kɛ ɛku me kɛmɔ ɛhunle Yigyibitinli ne la ɔ?’

Akee Mosisi zulole. Ɔnwunle kɛ menli ɛde mɔɔ ɔyɛle Yigyibitinli ne la. Falo bɔbɔ dele nwolɛ bie, na ɔzoanle menli kɛ bɛhɔhu Mosisi. Ɛhye ati a ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ Mosisi nriandi fi Yigyibiti a.

Mɔɔ Mosisi vile Yigyibiti la, ɔhɔle Medean azɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ moamoa la azo. Ɛkɛ ne a ɔnwunle Gyɛtulo abusua ne a, na ɔgyale ɔ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Zepɔla la. Mosisi rayɛle mboaneneavolɛ na ɔnleanle Gyɛtulo mboane ne mɔ. Ɔdɛnlanle Medean azɛlɛ zo ɛvolɛ 40. Ɛnee akee yenyia ɛvolɛ 80. Na kenle ko, mɔɔ ɛnee Mosisi ɛlɛnea Gyɛtulo mboane ne la, edwɛkɛ nwanwane bie zile mɔɔ hakyile Mosisi asetɛnla bɔkɔɔ a. Kɔ mukelɛ ne mɔɔ doa ye la, na maa yɛnlea nwanwane debie holɛ ko mɔɔ zile la.Adendulɛ 2:11-25; Gyima ne 7:22-29. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MOSISI ɛpɛ adenle toonwo ɛra Hɔlɛbe boka ne abo bakpondɛ ndile amaa ye mboane ne mɔ. Na ɔnwunle kpɔkɛ mɔɔ senle la nu ɔlɛsɔ, noko ɔnyela a!

Mosisi hanle ye ɔ ti anu kɛ: ‘Ɛhye yɛ nwanwane. Mebikye ye kpalɛ na meanwu ye boɛ.’ Mɔɔ ɔbikyele ye kpalɛ la, ɛnelɛ bie vi kpɔkɛ ne anu hanle kɛ: ‘Mmabikye ɛke bieko. Yeye wɔ mgbɔlaboa ne, ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛgyi zolɛ la le nwuanzanwuanza.’ Ɛnee Nyamenle a lua anwumabɔvolɛ nwo zo ɛlɛtendɛ a, ɔti Mosisi hedale ɔ nyunlu.

Akee Nyamenle hanle kɛ: ‘Menwu me menli mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la amaneɛnwunlɛ ne. Yemɔti mera kɛ mebalie bɛ, na wɔmɔ a mesoa wɔ meamaa wɔahɔye me menli ne wɔavi Yigyibiti a.’ Ɛnee Gyihova ɛlɛba arava ye menli ne ara Keena azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne azo.

Noko Mosisi hanle kɛ: ‘Menle awie. Kɛ mebazi meayɛ ɛhye ɛ? Na saa mekɔ a. Yizilayɛma ne babiza me kɛ, “Nwane a zoanle wɔ a?” Na saa bɛbiza me a, duzu a menga a?’

Nyamenle buale kɛ: ‘Ka ɛhye kile bɛ. “GYIHOVA mɔɔ le Ebileham Nyamenle ne, Ayezeke Nyamenle ne, nee Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ɛzoa me bɛ nwo ɛke.”’ Na Gyihova vale zɔle zolɛ kɛ: ‘Ɛhye a le me duma wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.’

Mosisi yele ɔ nloa kɛ: ‘Na saa meka kɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛzoanle me na bɛanlie me bɛanli ɛ.’

Nyamenle bizale kɛ: ‘Duzu a ɛlɛ ye ɛ sa nu la?’

Mosisi buale kɛ: ‘Kpɔma ɔ.’

Nyamenle zele kɛ: ‘Fuandi to azɛlɛ ne anwo.’ Na Mosisi yɛle zɔ la, kpɔma ne hakyile ɛwɔlɛ. Akee Gyihova hilele Mosisi sɛkɛlɛneɛ bieko. Ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Fa ɛ sa wula wɔ tɛladeɛ ne anu.’ Mosisi yɛle, na mɔɔ ɔyele ɔ sa la, ɛnee yeyɛ fufule nwohyee kɛ ezukɔtweaba! Ɛsalɛ ne yɛle kɛ kokobɛ ɛdila ye la. Mɔɔ doa ye bieko la, Gyihova manle Mosisi tumi mɔɔ ɔbava yeayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la. Awieleɛ kolaa ne ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Saa ɛyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛhye mɔ a Yizilayɛma balie ali kɛ medame a mezoa wɔ a.’

Ɛhye anzi, Mosisi hɔle sua nu hɔhanle hilele Gyɛtulo kɛ: ‘Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa me adenle maa menzia mengɔ Yigyibiti mengɔnea saa me nwo amra tɛte ngoane nu a.’ Yemɔti Gyɛtulo kponlenle zolɛ kɛ Mosisi ɛhɔ anzondwolɛ nu, na Mosisi bɔle ye adenle mɔɔ ɔtu yeazia yeahɔ Yigyibiti la abo.Adendulɛ 3:1-22; 4:1-20. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Mosisi Nee Aalɔn Kɔ Falo Anyunlu
data.contenido:
MEKƐ mɔɔ Mosisi ziale hɔle Yigyibiti la, ɔhanle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ amuala anwo edwɛkɛ ɔhilele ɔ diema nrenya Aalɔn. Na mɔɔ Mosisi nee Aalɔn yɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛhye mɔ hilele Yizilayɛma ne la, menli ne amuala liele lile kɛ Gyihova boka bɛ nwo.

Akee Mosisi nee Aalɔn hɔle Falo anyunlu. Bɛhanle bɛhilele ye kɛ: ‘Kɛ Gyihova, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se la ɛne, “Maa me menli ne ɛhɔ kenle nsa adenle, amaa bɛahola bɛazonle me wɔ fienemgbole ne anu.” ’ Noko Falo hanle kɛ: ‘Menze Gyihova. Na menrɛmaa Yizilayɛ ɛnrɛhɔ.’

Falo vale ɛya, ɔluakɛ menli ne kpondɛ kɛ ɔmaa bɛ mekɛ bɛgyakyi gyima na bɛkɔsonle Gyihova la ati. Zɔhane ati ɔhyele bɛ mialera nu ɔmanle bɛyɛle gyima ɛsesebɛ bɛdɛlale dɛba ne. Yizilayɛma ne dendɛle tiale Mosisi wɔ atisesebɛ adenle zo mɔɔ akee Yigyibitima nee bɛ lile ye la anwo, na nyane hunle Mosisi. Noko Gyihova hanle hilele ye kɛ ɔmmamaa ɔgyegye ye. Gyihova hanle kɛ: ‘Mebamaa Falo amaa me menli ne adenle bɛahɔ.’ Mosisi nee Aalɔn hɔle Falo anyunlu bieko. Na mekɛ ɛhye anu bɛyɛle nwanwane debie. Aalɔn vuandinle ye kpɔma ne dole aze, na ɔhakyile ɛwɔlɛ kpole bie. Na Falo nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne noko vuandinle agbɔma guale aze, na nwɔlɛ vindele. Noko, nea! Aalɔn ɛwɔlɛ deɛ ne ɛlɛmeme nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne nwɔlɛ ne mɔ. Noko Falo ammaa Yizilayɛma ne angɔ.

Yemɔti mekɛ dwule kɛ Gyihova kile Falo nrɛlɛbɛ. Ɛze kɛ ɔzile ɔyɛle ye la ɔ? Ɔlua ngyegyelɛ 10, anzɛɛ anwubɛnyunlu, mɔɔ ɔmanle ɔrale Yigyibiti anwo zo la.

Mɔɔ ɛnee ngyegyelɛ ne anu dɔɔnwo ɛra la, Falo manle bɛhɔvɛlɛle Mosisi, na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Maa ngyegyelɛ ne ɛpɛ, na mebamaa Yizilayɛ ahɔ.’ Noko saa ngyegyelɛ ne pɛ a, ɛnee Falo ɛhakyi ye adwenle. Ɔmmaa menli ne ɛngɔ. Noko, awieleɛ kolaa ne, wɔ ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ 10 la anzi, Falo manle Yizilayɛma ne hɔle.

Asoo ɛze ngyegyelɛ 10 ne anu ko biala ɔ? Kɔ mukelɛ ne mɔɔ doa ye la na maa yɛzukoa nwolɛ debie.Adendulɛ 4:27-31; 5:1-23; 6:1-13, 26-30; 7:1-13. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA nvoninli ne mɔ. Ko biala kile ngyegyelɛ mɔɔ Gyihova vale rale Yigyibiti anwo zo la. Wɔ nvoninli ne mɔɔ lumua la anu, ɛnwu Aalɔn kɛ ɔlɛfa ye kpɔma ne yeabɔ Azule Naele anu. Ɔyɛle la, nzule ne mɔɔ wɔ azudenle ne anu la hakyile mogya. Fɛlɛ ne mɔ wuwule, na azudenle ne bɔnle. Bieko, Gyihova manle ahɛlɛne vi Azule Naele anu rale. Ɛnee bɛwɔ ɛleka biala—bɛ fonlomo ne mɔ anu, kpanwo ahyɛnze nu, menli ɛzokpa zo—ɛleka biala. Mɔɔ ahɛlɛne ne mɔ wuwule la Yigyibitima ne mɔ huohuanle bɛ edukue edukue, na azɛlɛ ne azo amuala bɔnle.

Akee Aalɔn finle ye kpɔma ne aze, na munlutu ne hakyile ngokowule. Ɛhye mɔ le ngɛkɛba ngyikyi bie mɔɔ bɛtu na bɛkeka. Ngokowule ne mɔ a le ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa mɔɔ rale Yigyibiti azɛlɛ ne azo a. Ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ ɛha la hanle Yigyibitima ne ala, yeanga Yizilayɛma ne mɔ. Ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la le nrɛzenra mgbole bie mɔɔ yɛle Yigyibitima ne mɔ azua nu adɔka adɔka a. Ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nnu la hanle nyɛmoa. Yigyibitima ne nlankɛ nee mboane nee mbɔnkye dɔɔnwo wuwule.

Mɔɔ doa ye la, Mosisi nee Aalɔn vulale nzonle na bɛkpondenle ye anwomanyunlu. Ɔmanle nyila nwunwunle menli ne nee nyɛmoa ne mɔ. Ɛhye a le ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia a.

Ɛhye anzi, Mosisi dendenle ɔ sa anwomanyunlu, na Gyihova manle maanle nu hulule, na ezuawolɛ dɔle. Ɛnee ɔle ezuawolɛ mɔɔ bie ɛtɛtɔle Yigyibiti ɛlɛ a. Ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ mɔtwɛ la le abɛbɛ adɔka. Ɛnee abɛbɛ dɔɔnwo zɔhane bie ɛtɛbale ɛlɛ na yemɔ anzi noko bieko anzi. Bɛlile debie biala mɔɔ ezuawolɛ ne anzɛkye ye la amuala.

Ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ ngɔnla la le awozinli. Awozinli kabikabi vale azɛlɛ ne azo amuala toonwo kenle nsa, noko ɛnee wienyi wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne wɔ la.

Awieleɛ kolaa ne, Nyamenle hanle hilele ye menli ne kɛ bɛva abɔnkye anzɛɛ boane ralɛ mogya bɛha bɛ nlenkɛ ne felɛmo ne mɔ anwo. Akee Nyamenle anwumabɔvolɛ pɛle nu wɔ Yigyibiti. Saa anwumabɔvolɛ ne nwu mogya ne a, ɔngu awie biala wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne. Noko wɔ azua mɔɔ mogya ɛnle bɛ nlenkɛ ne felɛmo ne mɔ anwo la anu, Nyamenle anwumabɔvolɛ ne hunle menli nee nyɛmoa belamunli mralɛ kɔsɔɔti. Ɛhye a le ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ 10 ne a.

Ngyegyelɛ ɛhye mɔɔ li awieleɛ la anzi, Falo hanle hilele Yizilayɛma ne kɛ bɛvi ɛkɛ bɛhɔ. Ɛnee Nyamenle menli ne amuala ɛziezie bɛ nwo kɛ bɛkɔ, na kenle ko nɔe ne ala bɛvile Yigyibiti.Adendulɛ tile 7 kɔdwu 12. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA mɔɔ ɛlɛsi la! Mosisi a lɛ kpɔma ne mɔɔ yedende ye Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne azo la. Menli mɔɔ boka ɔ nwo mɔɔ ɛpɛ nyevile ne ɛwie la le Yizilayɛma. Noko nyevile ne ɛlɛfa Falo ne ye ɛlɔnema ne amuala. Maa yɛnlea kɛ ɛhye zile rale la.

Kɛmɔ yɛzukoa ye dɛba la, Falo manle Yizilayɛma ne adenle kɛ bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛhɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle manle ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ 10 la rale Yigyibitima anwo zo la anzi. Yizilayɛ mrenya mɔɔ bayɛ 600,000, yɛɛ akee mraalɛ nee ngakula dɔɔnwo a vile ɛkɛ hɔle a. Eza menli gyɛne dɔɔnwo, mɔɔ raliele Gyihova lile la, nee Yizilayɛma ne hɔle. Bɛ muala bɛvale bɛ mboane nee bɛ mbɔnkye yɛɛ bɛ nlankɛ bɛhɔle.

Kolaa na bɛahɔ la, Yizilayɛma ne bizale Yigyibitima liele ndanlɛ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa kɔkɔlɛ nee ezukoa fufule bɛyɛ la wɔ bɛ ɛkɛ. Ɔlua ngyegyelɛ ne mɔɔ li awieleɛ mɔɔ rale Yigyibitima anwo zo la ati, bɛ ahonle dule. Yemɔti bɛvale debie biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne bizale ye bɛ ɛkɛ ne la bɛmanle bɛ.

Mekɛ ekyi guale nu la Yizilayɛma ne radwule Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne anloa. Bɛliele bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ ɛkɛ. Wɔ mekɛ ɛhye anu, ɛnee Falo nee ye menli ne noko ɛnlu bɛ nwo kɛ bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ne ɛhɔ la. Bɛhanle kɛ: ‘Yɛmaa yɛ ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ ɛhɔ!’

Ɔti Falo eza hakyile ye adwenle bieko. Ɔzieziele ye konle ehwili ne nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ndɛndɛ. Na akee ɔvale konle ehwili mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye ngakyile la 600, yɛɛ Yigyibiti konle ehwili ne mɔ amuala na ɔdoale Yizilayɛma ne.

Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne nwunle kɛ Falo nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ɛlɛba bɛ nwo zo la, ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ. Ɛnee adenle biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛkola bɛfa zo bɛnriandi a. Ɛnee Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne la bɛ nyunlu, yɛɛ bɛto bɛ nye bɛ nzi a Yigyibitima a ɛpuke ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛba la. Noko Gyihova vale amungu pɛle ye menli ne nee Yigyibitima avinli. Yemɔti Yigyibitima ne annwu Yizilayɛma na bɛaholo bɛ nwo zo.

Akee Gyihova hanle hilele Mosisi kɛ ɔdende ye kpɔma ne wɔ Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne azo. Mɔɔ ɔyɛle la, Gyihova manle aduduleɛ anwoma anu ɛsesebɛ bie bɔle. Nyevile ne anu hyɛle nwiɔ, na nzule mɔɔ wɔ nyevile ne anu la dwazole bolonwonwo wɔ foa ko nee foa ko.

Na Yizilayɛma luale nyevile ne anu azɛlɛ resee ne azo. Dɔnehwele dɔɔnwo pɛle nu na menli mgbe mgbe ne nee bɛ nyɛmoa ne mɔ amuala ava bɛ nwo kɔlɔɔnwo apɛ nyevile ne ahɔ ɔ nzi. Awieleɛ kolaa ne Yigyibitima ne nwunle Yizilayɛma ne bieko. Bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ ɛlɛkɔ! Yemɔti bɛluale nyevile ne anu bɛdinle bɛ.

Mɔɔ bɛluale nuhua bie la, Nyamenle manle bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ agyakɛ miminle. Ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle Yigyibitima ne na bɛhanle kɛ: ‘Gyihova ɛlɛko atia yɛ amaa Yizilayɛma. Bɛmaa yɛnriandi yɛvi ɛke!’ Noko ɛnee yeha amozi somaa.

Mekɛ ko ne ala anu a Gyihova hanle hilele Mosisi kɛ ɔdende ye kpɔma ne wɔ Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne anu, kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye nvoninli ne anu la. Na mekɛ mɔɔ Mosisi yɛle la, nyevile ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ kɛ bane la yile bɔle nu na ɔhedale Yigyibitima nee bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ anwo zo. Ɛlɔnema ne kɔsɔɔti doale Yizilayɛma ne wɔ nyevile ne anu. Na Yigyibitima ne anu ko bɔbɔ anga! Nea kɛ Nyamenle menli ne amuala anye zile liele kɛ bɛliele bɛ ngoane a! Mrenya ne mɔ dole ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne manle Gyihova, kɛ: ‘Gyihova ɛli konim anyunlunyia nu. Yevuandi mgbɔnwɔ nee bɛ kavolɛ ne mɔ yegua nyevile ne anu.’ Mosisi adiema raalɛ Meleam vale ye akɛya, na mraalɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti vale bɛ akɛya doale ye. Na mɔɔ bɛlɛfa anyelielɛ bɛazi agole la, bɛdole edwɛne ko ne ala mɔɔ ɛnee mrenya ne mɔ ɛlɛto la bie kɛ: ‘Gyihova ɛli konim anyunlunyia nu. Yevuandi mgbɔnwɔ nee bɛ kavolɛ ne mɔ yegua nyevile ne anu.’Adendulɛ tile 12 kɔdwu 15. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia
